observations: Photo 0 shows a white front-load washing machine with the door open, revealing the drum. The brand 'SAMSUNG' is visible on the top left of the control panel.
Photo 1 shows the same machine with the door closed. The control panel includes a digital display, a dial, and buttons. The text 'Digital Inverter' is visible below the brand name.
On the right side of the control panel in photo 1, a sticker reads '7.5kg 6.5kg', indicating wash and dry capacities.
The machine appears to be in a warehouse or storage area with concrete flooring and other appliances in the background.
The door seal and drum interior appear clean and intact in both photos.
No visible damage to the exterior casing or control panel is evident.
